The company says they cannot reverse it and I have to ask the recipient myself. There should be a way to recover a payment sent by mistake.

2.text: Their phone line says to use the app and the app says to call the phone line. I have been a customer for 6 years. A company that holds people's money should have real customer service.

11.text: My account was hacked and the password and security settings were changed before I could do anything. The company should have flagged a new device changing every security setting at once.
